title: Fox Tame / Tameable Fox
description: Adds the ability to tame foxes in Minecraft, similar to wolves and cats.
body:
# Fox Taming

Adds the ability to tame foxes in Minecraft, similar to wolves and cats.

## Features

- **Taming** — feed a wild fox sweet berries for a chance to tame it (same odds as taming a cat).
- **Sit / Stand** — right-click your tamed fox with an empty hand to toggle sitting. While sitting, it stays in place and won't wander off or react to nearby prey.
- **Follow** — when not sitting, your fox follows you around.
- **Teleport** — if it falls too far behind (fell off a cliff, you took a boat, etc.), it teleports back to your side instead of getting lost.
- No longer flees from you once tamed — the usual fox skittishness toward players is removed for tamed foxes.
- Tamed state, owner, and sitting status are saved with the fox and persist across sessions.

## Notes

- Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API.
